summary: Upload drop zone where the file icon dissolves pixel by pixel into the progress bar, which regroups into a check; oversized files shake red.

attributes.name: limit-mb
attributes.description: Size limit in megabytes (1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes); a missing, invalid or non-positive value uses 30. Read each time a file is started.

events.name: error
events.description: Fires when a file is over the limit. `size` is in bytes. Does not bubble, so it never reaches the window's global `error` handlers; listen on the element.

events.name: uploaded
events.description: Fires when the simulated upload completes. `size` is in bytes.

methods.description: Runs the upload animation for a file of `size` bytes. Ignored unless the component is idle, and for a size that is not a finite number of at least 0.
Returns to the idle drop zone. After a success the check flies back into the file icon.

properties.name: limit
properties.description: The size limit in bytes, from `limit-mb`; 30 MB when it is missing, invalid or not positive.

keyboard.action: Open the file picker while idle.

accessibility: The drop zone is focusable with `role="button"` and `aria-label="Upload a file: click or drop"`.

The status line ("Uploading …", "Uploaded", "Over the 30 MB limit") sits in the drop zone and is repeated in a visually hidden `aria-live="polite"` region beside it, because assistive technology does not read the content of a button.
"Use a sample file" and "Try a 48 MB file" are native buttons.
motion: With reduced motion, the icon does not bob, the border does not march, an error does not shake and pixels jump to the bar and the check instead of arcing.
notes: Nothing is sent over the network. A chosen or dropped file is used only for its name and size, and progress is simulated over 1.6 to 3.4 seconds depending on size.
The two demo buttons start a 2.4 MB sample and a 48.2 MB file that exceeds the default limit. Only the first file of a drop is used.
The host carries `data-state="uploading"`, `"error"` or `"done"`, and returns to idle 2.6 seconds after an error and 2.8 seconds after success.

data.note: Nothing is uploaded and the progress is simulated; the file name and size come from the chosen file and `limit-mb` can be set.
